facts.en: Earned a software testing diploma at Fictional Birchlogic College in 2024.
facts.zh: 2024 年在虚构桦逻辑学院获得软件测试文凭。

facts.en: Paid robotics software test assistant at Fictional Mosscart Systems from 2024-08 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-08 至 2026-08 在虚构苔车系统公司任有薪机器人软件测试助理。

facts.en: Runs approved regression scenarios in a warehouse-robot simulator and records software version and map configuration.
facts.zh: 在仓储机器人模拟器中运行获批回归场景，并记录软件版本及地图配置。

facts.en: Writes Python assertions for route-status messages and task-cancellation responses within the existing test framework.
facts.zh: 在现有测试框架中编写 Python 断言，检查路线状态消息及任务取消响应。

facts.en: Files reproducible defects with logs and expected behavior from the approved test specification.
facts.zh: 依据获批测试规格中的预期行为，附日志提交可复现缺陷。

facts.en: A senior test engineer reviews the assertions and decides whether a failed check is a product defect or a test issue.
facts.zh: 高级测试工程师审核断言，并决定失败检查属于产品缺陷还是测试问题。

facts.en: Contributed to a 2025-10 simulator regression run containing 180 scenario executions.
facts.zh: 参与一轮 2025-10 模拟器回归运行，包含 180 次场景执行。

facts.en: The run used 60 scenario definitions executed under 3 map configurations each.
facts.zh: 该轮运行使用 60 个场景定义，每个在 3 种地图配置下执行。

facts.en: There were 14 failed executions in the recorded run; these were not confirmed as 14 distinct defects.
facts.zh: 记录中的运行有 14 次执行失败；未确认其等同于 14 个不同缺陷。

facts.en: Personally maintained assertions for 8 scenario definitions; colleagues maintained the remaining scenarios and simulator infrastructure.
facts.zh: 个人维护 8 个场景定义的断言；同事维护其余场景及模拟器基础设施。

facts.en: The release owner approves deployment to physical robots; the candidate has simulator test access only.
facts.zh: 发布负责人批准向实体机器人部署；候选人仅拥有模拟器测试访问权限。

facts.en: Uses Python, Git reviews, test logs and an issue tracker.
facts.zh: 使用 Python、Git 评审、测试日志及问题跟踪系统。

facts.en: Completed internal simulator and defect-reporting induction in 2024-08.
facts.zh: 2024-08 完成内部模拟器及缺陷报告入职培训。

facts.en: Built a personal grid-navigation puzzle in 2023 using a simple Python program and invented map data.
facts.zh: 2023 年使用简单 Python 程序及虚构地图数据制作个人网格导航谜题。

facts.en: The puzzle ran on a laptop and did not control motors, sensors or real vehicles.
facts.zh: 该谜题在笔记本电脑上运行，不控制电机、传感器或真实车辆。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Codeacorn Club in 2022, checking sign-ins for beginner programming sessions.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构代码橡子社做志愿者，为入门编程活动核对签到。

facts.en: Enjoys assembling paper mazes and playing cooperative puzzle board games.
facts.zh: 爱好组装纸迷宫及玩合作式解谜桌游。

facts.en: Explains simulator reproduction steps at team defect-triage meetings.
facts.zh: 在团队缺陷分类评估会议上解释模拟器复现步骤。

facts.en: Keeps unresolved flaky checks separate from consistently reproducible failures in test summaries.
facts.zh: 在测试摘要中将尚未解决的不稳定检查与能够稳定复现的失败分开。

facts.en: No authority for robot safety certification or on-site emergency-stop validation is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录机器人安全认证或现场急停验证权限。
